mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tasks, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN completed = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_tasks, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN completed = FALSE AND due_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_tasks FROM todos WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT DATE(completed_at) AS completion_date, COUNT(*) AS task_count FROM todos WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND completed = TRUE AND completed_at >= #{startDate} AND completed_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(completed_at) ORDER BY completion_date
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS task_count FROM todos WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY task_count DESC, category

SELECT id, title, category, priority, due_date, completed, completed_at, created_at FROM todos WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND completed = FALSE AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND (due_date < CURDATE() OR due_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 DAY)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN due_date < CURDATE() THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, due_date ASC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
